captured.scope: Deterministic offline source/adapter/Git/CI integration; no native E2E or model evaluation

requiredObservables: Exact purpose and normative clauses recoverable by source address and value
Original decision/question relationship and authored next action survive
Historical Task contract remains historical while current Work revision advances
Relevant uncertain effects hold; unrelated authorized source work remains usable
Unfit complete output honestly holds, without partial qualified contract
cases.expected: Both adapter envelopes recover exact authored purpose, originals, historical/current revisions and next action; relevant uncertain effect holds; unrelated Task is usable; too-small cap yields no qualified partial contract.
cases.negativeControl: Drop an original binding or truncate next action while retaining SELECTED/fit: independent assertion must reject.
cases.claimRule: No new behavior gain without observed same-input baseline failure and candidate repair; seeded fault is synthetic.

requiredObservables: No unnecessary HOLD for a valid supported selection
No distinct original, ordering or source binding lost by deduplication
Correct holds for truly invalid input remain
No native permission or runtime consumption inferred from pure hook source execution
cases.expected: Task plus repeated associated Decision remains selected, distinct Decisions and superseded originals retain authored order on both Codex events; unsupported selection holds.
cases.negativeControl: Duplicate an associated Decision ID or remove a distinct original: independent assertion must reject.
cases.claimRule: No new behavior gain without observed same-input baseline failure and candidate repair; seeded fault is synthetic.

requiredObservables: Same logical Task and exact historical/current contract recovered
Purpose, original reasons, delegated result source/hash and next action recovered
Completed/uncertain operation not replayed
Independent permitted work does not become globally blocked
Recovered progress is useful actual work, not only a context SELECTED label
cases.expected: Completed and uncertain consumed Tasks cannot replay; distinct source-only Task recovers exact next action and remains usable, even with absent old pane.
cases.negativeControl: Clear a completed/uncertain fence in an integrated tree: semantic transition must reject.
cases.claimRule: No new behavior gain without observed same-input baseline failure and candidate repair; seeded fault is synthetic.

requiredObservables: Valid unchanged source succeeds
Changed canary never executes
Late drift withholds output and private payload
All preexisting/third-state bytes remain exact
Partial completed writes remain recorded without blind retry/rollback
cases.expected: Unchanged closure succeeds, changed executable refuses before execution; third-state collision stays byte-exact and partial delivery records only actual completed writes.
cases.negativeControl: Mutate an admitted source after initial observation or collide a target: public guard/delivery refuses without canary execution/overwrite.
cases.claimRule: No new behavior gain without observed same-input baseline failure and candidate repair; seeded fault is synthetic.

requiredObservables: Completed historical Task keeps its bound Spec/Plan
Original decisions and effect fences survive
Real cycle is rejected; equivalent noncyclic control allowed
Proof/archive remains with existing custody owner and typed references
Only affected dependencies are repaired; independent valid work retained
cases.expected: Acyclic integration allows independent Tasks and historical contracts; combined dependency cycle and raw proof inside typed Work refuse.
cases.negativeControl: Merge individually acyclic Task edits into a cycle or replace typed Input with raw proof: public Work reader/transition rejects.
cases.claimRule: No new behavior gain without observed same-input baseline failure and candidate repair; seeded fault is synthetic.

requiredObservables: Correct source and reviewed tree are bound explicitly
Missing evidence never becomes PASS or actual source defect by assertion
Wrong publisher/stale finding is rejected
Permitted evidence arrival and valid reviewed reuse can be consumed without blind native/effect replay
Temporary infrastructure/result state and whole consumer quality remain distinct
cases.expected: Exact source/tree trusted review succeeds; missing proof remains absent/pending within bounded wait, held/wrong publisher/new unresolved finding fails. Eighteen historical ordering incidents are evidence timing, not eighteen source defects.
cases.negativeControl: Wrong creator or newer held status must reject; absent status never passes merely because source checks pass.
cases.claimRule: No new behavior gain without observed same-input baseline failure and candidate repair; seeded fault is synthetic.

requiredObservables: Git-owned readers consume a complete intended tree, never an unreviewed partial candidate.
Late source/ref/dependency changes preserve third states and independent valid work.
Original meaning and historical contracts survive integration and recovery.
Correct normal consumer progress is retained; more HOLDs alone are not quality improvement.
Any remaining native guarantee is stated at the actual owner/operation boundary with evidence and uncertainty.
Do not confuse a fixture-proven limitation with an observed production failure or a mandatory universal guarantee.
cases.expected: Git publication reads a complete committed tree, expected-ref CAS refuses stale head preserving third state, and history/original/fences remain accessible; native private apply remains unexecuted.
cases.negativeControl: Advance ref between expected-head observation and update-ref: stale CAS must fail and exact newer commit remain.
cases.claimRule: No new behavior gain without observed same-input baseline failure and candidate repair; seeded fault is synthetic.

content.claim: Pre-observation engineering contract/oracles; caller evidence is not native permission or source authentication.
